Flu.name: Paracetamol 500mg
Flu.dosage: 1 tablet 3 times daily after meals (max 3 days)
Flu.warning: Do not exceed 4g per day. Avoid alcohol. Consult a doctor if fever lasts more than 3 days.

Migraine.name: Sumatriptan 50mg
Migraine.dosage: 1 tablet at onset of headache (max 2 tablets per day)
Migraine.warning: Not recommended for patients with heart disease. Consult a neurologist.

Gastritis.name: Pantoprazole 40mg
Gastritis.warning: Do not use long term without medical supervision.
